title: General Claude usage, documentation and addons
author: Middle_Ad630
selftext:
Hello, 

I’ve been working on a game for some time now and it’s getting bigger and bigger.   
Sometimes I feels that Claude loses track of already set rules and plan even though we use docs for everything and I also try to keep up and document the steps.  
With all that, the other issue is the token usage that’s getting heavier.

I’d love to know if you guys have some tips or experience when it comes to larger scale game dev with AI.  
What strategies you use. How often you start new chats with the agent.  
If you are using Claude cowork or code   
Or if you have experience with Claude addons to improve workflow and token usage. (I’m so skeptical here reading how many say that you have to use things like PonyTail and so on while others say that it can drastically reduce the quality of the work of Claude)

Maybe some of you can share some of their own experience with me! :)
